```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  // Details handed over by the subscribe form (sessionStorage, never the URL).
  const welcome = SalemList.recall("welcome");
  if (!welcome) return; // generic confirmation

  const name = (welcome.firstName || "").trim();
  const withName = function (text) { return name ? text + ", " + name + "." : text + "."; };
  const heading = document.getElementById("welcome-heading");
  const lede = document.getElementById("welcome-lede");
  const copy = document.getElementById("welcome-copy");

  if (welcome.status === "resubscribed") {
    heading.textContent = withName("Welcome back");
    lede.textContent = "You are subscribed to Salem Custom Screen Printing again.";
    copy.textContent = "We’re glad you’re back. Look out for a welcome note in your inbox with fresh links to manage your emails.";
  } else if (welcome.audience === "returning") {
    heading.textContent = withName("Good to see you again");
    copy.textContent = "We’ll let you know when custom order spots open, so your next round of shirts is easy. Look out for a welcome note in your inbox.";
  } else {
    heading.textContent = withName("Welcome to Salem");
  }
});
</script>
```
